verdict.rationale: Docs show per-seller balances can be retrieved by calling the balance API as the connected account. They also show that charges can be split between the platform and sellers, and that payouts to connected accounts can be managed and scheduled. That covers the building blocks of the money flow, but nothing in the pack shows a ledger view tying a charge through its split to the payout, or reconciliation reporting. Missing for 10: platform fee-account balance visibility, end-to-end traceability from charge to split to payout, penny-level reconciliation reports or exports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
